headline: Recurring app crashes tie to an outdated GPU driver plus a failing storage controller driver.

root_causes.evidence: Photoshop faults in atio6axx.dll; newest GPU driver dated 2022-06-15 (over 3 years old)
2 Kernel-Power 41 plus a 6008 dirty shutdown around the BSOD timestamps

driver_actions.why: 2019 driver correlates with storahci 153 disk timeout events
faulting module in repeated Photoshop crashes

recommended_actions: Update the Intel Graphics and Intel RST drivers from Dell's OptiPlex 7040 support page
Run chkdsk and confirm SMART on the SATA SSD (153 timeouts seen)
Check the PSU / power connection given the dirty shutdowns
customer_summary: Your PC has been crashing mainly because two important drivers are out of date and the machine lost power unexpectedly a few times. Updating those drivers and checking the power should make it stable again.

updates.item: GPU driver — NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER
updates.advice: Install the current NVIDIA Game Ready/Studio driver (5xx branch) from nvidia.com — the 466.27 driver is five years old and predates several stability fixes.
Dell has released newer 1.2x BIOS revisions with microcode and firmware fixes — update from dell.com/support (needs AC power).
Install the current Intel Chipset Device Software (10.1.19xxx+) from Dell's support page for this model.
Update to the current Intel RST driver from the Dell support page; keep the same RST major branch if RAID/Optane is in use.
Windows 10 reached end of support on 2025-10-14 — upgrade to Windows 11 (this PC passes the hardware check) or enrol in Extended Security Updates.
